verifications.claim: Applicant match status is available via email at 12:00 p.m. ET on Friday, March 20, 2026.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Match Status Notification Monday... At 10:00 AM ET... sent by email'; 'Match Day! Friday... At 12:00 PM ET, Match results are sent by email'; R3: 'March 16, 2026... at 10 am ET. This is when you will receive an email... whether you have matched'; R6: 'Monday, March 16, 2026, when residency applicants receive notifications indicating whether they have matched'; R8: 'March 16, 2026: Applicant match status available at 10 a.m. ET'
verifications.reasoning: Sources distinguish 'match status' (if matched, Monday 10am via email) from Friday results (where matched, 12pm via email); claim incorrectly attributes match status to Friday.

verifications.claim: Applicant match status is available via the R3 system at 12:00 p.m. ET on Friday, March 20, 2026.

verifications.evidence: R1: 'Monday... applicants... can use...
